nodes.label: EPIC: SHEFA First-Clinic System
nodes.rationale: The user expanded beyond the approved wedge: land-and-expand stays in scope as discover-then-build children and the full dashboard contract is kept.

nodes.label: Child 0: Developer Loop (shefa doctor / replay / bench / serve)
nodes.rationale: First success needed trunk, PBX, GPU and voice; replay gives time-to-hello-world on a fresh clone and ships before Children 1-3.

nodes.label: Child 1: Local Telephony Media Path
nodes.rationale: The wedge's spine; the transport-agnostic pipeline needs only a thin adapter, and rollback keeps the Twilio dev path.

nodes.label: Child 2: Safety-Net Conversation
nodes.rationale: Constrains the dialogue for trust; the text still states disclosure from ring one, which the Eng forward-semantics finding calls physically impossible.

nodes.label: Child 3: Lead Sink + Full Dashboard
nodes.rationale: The value unit is the captured callback lead; full D4 is a user override of the wedge's minimal view.

nodes.label: Child 4: Test the Real Loop + Calibration + Uptime
nodes.rationale: The proven loop is the gate, pinned to 2s median parse-to-reply (Q11).

nodes.label: Child 5: Runbook + Dev Docs
nodes.rationale: SIP-flavored versions of X1, X2, X4, X6, X7 and X8; doc stubs ship earlier in Child 1 so docs do not trail four code children.

nodes.label: Child 6: Demo Deliverable
nodes.rationale: A 60-second Bangla video of the proven loop, adjusted to loop-first per P2.

nodes.label: Child 7: Booking Depth + HMS Paste-In
nodes.rationale: The land-and-expand seam, gated so HMS discovery runs before any HMS-bound build.

nodes.label: Child 8: Multi-Branch / Fleet Deployment
nodes.rationale: Playbook seed, not a build: the network play is phase two and may re-derive as partner-led.

nodes.label: MediaBridge Interface
nodes.rationale: Keeps ESL deferrable behind one interface and bridges the PSTN leg to the pipeline queues.

nodes.label: AsteriskARIAdapter
nodes.rationale: Ships first and only (D7, D18), since two adapters double the blast radius.

nodes.label: FreeSWITCHESLAdapter
nodes.rationale: Deferred until a demand survey shows BD clinics run FreeSWITCH.

nodes.label: CallControl Plane
nodes.rationale: D-ENG3: the largest unestimated build; the emergency design could not hold, release, transfer or terminate a call, and transfer_to_human was a stub.

nodes.label: CallLeg Handle
nodes.rationale: VoicePipeline stops owning adapter lifecycle, fixing the orphaned create_task and its spinning loop.

nodes.label: AudioFrame Audio Contract
nodes.rationale: D-ENG4: the 16kHz mono contract did not exist; bytes were mis-typed and three sample rates coexisted, so the golden fixture became a Child 1 criterion.

nodes.label: Single telephony.provider Knob
nodes.rationale: D-ENG13: two provider knobs had undefined precedence, so startup rejects the two-key state; the Child 1 telephony.sip.provider text is superseded.

nodes.label: Self-Originated Loop Proof
nodes.rationale: D3: the loop is provable with a local originate to a softphone at zero procurement; the trunk is a pilot dependency, not a proof dependency.

nodes.label: Trunk-vs-Twilio Cost Guardrail
nodes.rationale: The trunk becomes the pilot path only if it costs no more than Twilio at 500 min/month, otherwise owner sign-off records the reason.

nodes.label: Twilio Dev Sink (Test-Only)
nodes.rationale: Retained additively (Q5) but test-only: the WSS host bug prevents routing and three permanent paths are avoided (D19).

nodes.label: On-Call Allow-List + Emergency Fail-Safe
nodes.rationale: D1: in the unstaffed window a desk transfer targets a closed desk, so it targets a person, with recorded instruction, a 20-second release and an SMS.

nodes.label: Intent-Router-Primary Emergency Detection
nodes.rationale: D-DES1: a keyword list is the weakest safety mechanism for non-clinical callers; keywords may only add paths and two unparsed turns force a transfer-or-DTMF offer.

nodes.label: Named Human Emergency-Script Sign-Off
nodes.rationale: D-DES2: the demo raced the safety sign-off, so a dated sign-off is a prerequisite of the Child 6 DoD.

nodes.label: Two-Directional Emergency Phrase Safety
nodes.rationale: D-ENG17: a thin list plus a substring trap; tests assert canonical phrases transfer and a benign-urgent corpus does not.

nodes.label: Per-Intent PHI Non-Disclosure
nodes.rationale: D9: result and billing intents never confirm a result or that the caller is the patient.

nodes.label: Exception Taxonomy + Terminal Transition
nodes.rationale: D-ENG12: a bare except spun at 10 iterations/s; counters, backoff and a terminal transition close the call on the Nth failure.

nodes.label: Recovered Appointment North-Star Metric
nodes.rationale: D2: the plan confused building a pipeline with selling recovered appointments; the report decomposes missed, captured, notified, callback, kept.

nodes.label: SQLite calls Table as Sole Dashboard Source
nodes.rationale: D12: app-level and pipeline-level SessionManager instances split, so /api/v1/sessions cannot see pipeline sessions and is deprecated with a 410.

nodes.label: Durable SQLite audit_log
nodes.rationale: D-ENG9: stdout structlog cannot back audited-delete or D5, so an append-only table holds tombstones and daily COUNT reconciliation.

nodes.label: Dashboard v1 + 50-Calls-per-Week Gate
nodes.rationale: D8: full D4 is a post-volume artifact, so a minimal honest view ships for pilot weeks.

nodes.label: Offline-vs-Empty Dashboard State
nodes.rationale: D-DES3: an unavailable line must never render as an empty 0-missed day; the banner derives from the heartbeat row.

nodes.label: Read-Back DTMF Key Map
nodes.rationale: D-DES4: 1=confirm, 2=repeat, *=desk over RFC4733 on both adapters, with trunk availability verified during the E4 screen.

nodes.label: shefa bench Abort Gate + Persistent Piper
nodes.rationale: D-ENG6, D-ENG18: subprocess TTS cannot meet 2s; the epic aborts on warm p50 > 1.2s, p95 > 2.0s or VRAM > 80%, with cold start reported separately.

nodes.label: Bangla Piper Voice Named Blocker
nodes.rationale: D-ENG5: only en_US-lessac exists on disk, so doctor must assert the resolved adapter path is the Bangla voice, parallel to trunk procurement.

nodes.label: Blind Bangla Listener Test
nodes.rationale: At least 3 native speakers rate comprehension and acceptance before the demo is cut; PA4 challenged stack readiness.

nodes.label: Demand Check Stop Point
nodes.rationale: D-ENG28, D11: at least 5 clinics and 3 trials assessed before Child 6 spend; a negative verdict halts trunk-linked build.

nodes.label: Two Distinct Consent Scripts
nodes.rationale: D16: call-time recording disclosure and marketing consent are never interchangeable.

nodes.label: HMS/EMR Channel Discovery
nodes.rationale: D15: multi-branch is a distribution problem rather than an engineering one, so test partner appetite before fleet work.

nodes.label: Config Substrate Reshape (extra=forbid)
nodes.rationale: D-ENG1: undeclared YAML shapes were silently dropped; forbid lands last in its own commit so it cannot cascade into boot failure.

nodes.label: STT Confidence from Segment Evidence
nodes.rationale: D-ENG2: 1.0 - language_probability fires transfer when Whisper is certain; split is_emergency from needs_repeat, regression test first.

nodes.label: Child 0 Authn/Authz on All Routes
nodes.rationale: D-ENG7: zero auth, a hardcoded dialable number and a stub authz logging authorized True exposed PHI on an open port.

nodes.label: BD/E.164 PHI Masking
nodes.rationale: D-ENG8: the US 10-digit regex missed every BD caller ID and logging.basicConfig bypassed the configured logger. Masking is per-sink; the emergency SMS deliberately keeps the number.

nodes.label: RMS VAD + Noise Floor
nodes.rationale: D-ENG11: the 15-tick timeout never fires under continuous noise and grows the buffer unboundedly.

nodes.label: HTTP Error Envelope + Status Map
nodes.rationale: D-ENG14: 4xx acceptance criteria contradicted the 200-with-error-body API style.

nodes.label: Turn-Group History Truncation
nodes.rationale: D-ENG15: truncation orphaned tool messages, which loses the turn on a 400.

nodes.label: OTHER Language State
nodes.rationale: D-ENG16: unsupported languages were coerced to English; they now go straight to a warm transfer-or-DTMF offer.

nodes.label: 41-Item Disposition Obligation (D-ENG19)
nodes.rationale: T7 had no child and T1, T2, T3, T6 and T8 were at risk, so a table ships as a Child 0 artifact (Eng task T16).

nodes.label: models.adapters Single Model-Config Source
nodes.rationale: D-ENG20: the Q12 fix was cosmetic with a third hardcoded value (11434 vs 8080); Q12 now asserts the resolved key and no model literal in the registry.

nodes.label: Bounded Media Queues + Concurrency Asserts
nodes.rationale: D-ENG21, D-ENG22: unbounded queues plus a breaking playback worker leak silently; instance-attr registry makes tests order-independent.

nodes.label: Coverage Floor Ratchet
nodes.rationale: D-ENG27: 100% was called the repo standard while the measured floor was 47%, so land 47 and ratchet; rewritten modules reach 100% themselves. Reconciles the DX =100 DoD.

nodes.label: Single jinja2 Prompt Loader + Per-Clinic Override
nodes.rationale: D-ENG24, D-DX22: plain system.md load drops interpolation; per-clinic override makes multi-clinic config rather than a code fork.

nodes.label: Full-String ENV_VAR Interpolation
nodes.rationale: D-ENG26, D-DX13: unset variables passed through literally and caused dial or auth failures; startup lists every unresolved var.

nodes.label: DRY_RUN Rehearsal Flag
nodes.rationale: D-DX26: emergency SMS, desk notification and on-call transfer need rehearsal without firing.

nodes.label: Retention Split (compliance vs dashboard)
nodes.rationale: D-DX24: resolves the 2555-day default vs T+14 delete contradiction in behavior rather than prose.

nodes.label: Eng Verdict: NOT READY (6 Blockers + 4 Criticals)
nodes.rationale: The plan was written one layer above the code and scheduled criteria against contracts that do not exist; findings are unreplicated because no second model ran.

nodes.label: Named External Blockers
nodes.rationale: Trunk procurement, Bangla voice, demand verdict, emergency sign-off and on-call staffing need owners and explicit gates.

nodes.label: Cross-Phase Review Themes
nodes.rationale: Hard loop proof, Bangla-first as product and test, evidence over prose, named blockers, and one source of truth converged across all phases.
